messages.subject: Reliable group size estimates
parts:
Hi=20Leonardo,

On=20Tue,=205=20Aug=202003=2016:26:53=20-0300,=20Leonardo=20Colombo=20Flec=
k=20wrote:

> >Hello,

> >I=20have=20conducted=20surveys=20on=20wildlife=20in=20the=20Amazon=20but=20=
I=20am=20facing=20a
> >problem:=20=20I=20don=B4t=20have=20good=20estimates=20of=20group=20sizes=20=
for=20all=20groups,=20just
> >some=20of=20them.=20How=20could=20I=20deal=20with=20this=20problem=20usin=
g=20Distance?

> >Thank=20you=20very=20much,

> >Leonardo

I'm=20forwarding=20my=20reply=20to=20the=20list=20as=20it's=20something=20=
I've=20been=20asked=20before.=20=20
The=20answer=20depends=20on=20what=20process=20led=20to=20some=20group=20s=
izes=20being=20unreliable.=20=20

It=20is=20quite=20common=20for=20the=20quality=20of=20group=20size=20estim=
ates=20to=20be=20related=20to=20
distance=20from=20the=20line=20--=20group=20sizes=20at=20large=20distances=
=20tend=20to=20be=20under-
estimated=20as=20you=20can't=20see=20the=20whole=20group.=20=20In=20this=20=
case=20you=20can=20use=20the=20size-
bias=20regression=20facility=20in=20Distance=20to=20correct=20for=20this.=20=
=20You=20have=20to=20assume=20
that=20the=20group=20sizes=20on=20the=20track=20line=20(or=20at=20probabil=
ity=20of=20detection=3D1)=20are=20
correct=20for=20this=20to=20work.=20=20The=20options=20are=20under=20under=
=20Model=20Definition=20|=20
Cluster=20size=20and=20are=20explained=20in=20the=20Introduction=20to=20Di=
stance=20Sampling=20book.=20=20
Note=20that=20if=20your=20average=20group=20size=20does=20indeed=20decline=
=20with=20increasing=20
distance=20you'll=20get=20a=20warning=20from=20Distance=20when=20you=20run=
=20the=20analysis,=20but=20you=20
can=20ignore=20this.

Another=20scenario=20is=20that=20some=20of=20your=20group=20sizes=20are=20=
unreliable=20"at=20random"=20--=20
in=20other=20words=20the=20distribution=20of=20reliable=20group=20sizes=20=
is=20representative=20of=20the=20
group=20sizes=20in=20the=20population.=20=20Then,=20you=20want=20to=20trea=
t=20the=20cluster=20size=20of=20the=20
unreliable=20clusters=20as=20"unknown".=20=20You=20can=20use=20these=20obs=
ervations=20for=20fitting=20
the=20detection=20function,=20but=20not=20for=20estimating=20cluster=20siz=
e.=20=20If=20this=20applies=20to=20
you=20then=20you're=20in=20luck=20because=20I=20just=20added=20the=20facil=
ity=20to=20include=20unknown=20
cluster=20sizes=20in=20Distance=20(thanks=20to=20Jay=20Barlow=20for=20prom=
pting=20me=20to=20do=20it)=20--=20
you=20simply=20code=20them=20as=20cluster=20size=20of=200.=20=20This=20isn=
't=20documented=20in=20the=20manual=20
yet,=20but=20it's=20in=20the=20ReadMe=20file=20(in=20Distance,=20choose=20=
Help=20|=20Release=20Notes=20and=20
look=20under=20New=20Features=20in=20Release=202).

Hope=20this=20helps,

=20-=20Len
